title: AutoClock: Automated Clock Management for Power-Efficient HLS Designs on FPGAs
problem: FPGA high-level synthesis tools lack comprehensive clock management solutions; diverse clock resources create a large design space and multi-clock domain handling is inefficient, leading to suboptimal power consumption.
motivation: Clock management is critical to FPGA performance, area, and especially power, but HLS tools provide no automated optimization of clock configurations.
method: AutoClock is an integrated clock management framework that allocates clock resources, assigns modules to clock domains, addresses metastability and time-division multiplexing issues, and hierarchically gates clocks. The tool uses heuristics and constraint satisfaction to optimize clock domain assignments and gating.
key_novelty: Automated multi-clock domain optimization and hierarchical clock gating in HLS that addresses metastability and TDM challenges.
contributions: Comprehensive clock resource allocation for FPGA designs
Module-to-clock-domain assignment addressing metastability and TDM issues
Hierarchical clock gating for dynamic power reduction
Up to 74.38% dynamic power consumption reduction
baselines: AMD Vitis HLS default clock management
limitations: Limited evaluation on specific FPGA architectures; scalability to very large designs and cross-device portability not discussed.
primary_theme: automated clock management for FPGA power efficiency
